integrity: The elliptic-curve transformation and local descent obstructions were reconstructed symbolically; exact finite-field point counts and explicit points are replayed by the included checker. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-exception fully nonzero three-dimensional family is classified; the general fully nonzero PSI_3 conjecture and the two-distinct-exception problem remain open. The proof invokes standard two-isogeny descent.
title: Rigidity of the one-exception three-dimensional PSI family
